lethality_blade_mode_end_phase_only.conversion: @Inject HEAD (cancellable) of BladeModeEvents.onPlayerTick and HFMeowrasamaEvents.onPlayerTick: the handler returns unless the event's phase is END, so Blade Mode's area slowness and speed modifiers run once per player tick instead of twice. Trade-off, off by default: on the tick Blade Mode ends nearby mobs miss the START refresh (their slowness ends a tick earlier), the speed modifiers change at the END of a tick instead of its START, and listeners see one MobEffectEvent pair less per mob per tick. Runtime flag lethalityBladeModeEndPhaseOnly. Helper bons.furious.patch.lethality_coo49.LethalityBladeMode.
